title: Surreal Cosmic Theater
description: A surreal scene shows three women in 1920s flapper attire seated in a wooden theater box, watching a performance. To the left floats a giant split-color teddy bear with a red bow, while an astronaut sits on a glowing purple rock platform connected by energy beams to a brown horse on the right. A pond with a white lotus flower sits in the foreground.
